peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (24.8): 1.9 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 64 of 266 similar developments with a figure (the same as 4). Context, not scored: resales in 8.3% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Kembangan MRT about 510 m, Eunos MRT about 690 m; closer than 259 of 462 similar developments (the same as 3). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 9 within 2 km; nearest ST. Stephen's School about 890 m; more than 242 of 462 similar developments (the same as 97). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 630 m), more than 56 of 462 similar developments (the same as 149); nearest hawker centre Eunos Crescent Blk 4a about 610 m; nearest park Telok Kurau Park about 500 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Straits at Joo Chiat, 3 new sales, about 370 m; Claydence, 8 new sales, about 630 m; K Suites, 6 new sales, about 640 m; Koon Seng House, 6 new sales, about 840 m; Verdé Joo Chiat, 9 new sales, about 860 m; Ardor Residence, 13 new sales, about 1,720 m; The Continuum, 208 new sales, about 1,800 m; Emerald of Katong, 2 new sales, about 1,950 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 385 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 266 new sales and 766 resales (1,032 purchases); new sales were 25.8% of these purchases. Subsales (19) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 766 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 285 of 462 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 766 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 879 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−12.9%). Planning-area private resales −7.9%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
